logp.method_description: Partition coefficients were measured at 25 ◦C. Briefly, water (5 cm3 ) saturated with 1-octanol was added to each vial containing weighed amounts of a copper(II) complex. Then 1 cm3 of each of these preparative solutions was pipetted into three cuvettes. To each cuvette, 1-octanol (9 cm3 ) saturated with water was added. These solutions were then stoppered and shaken for 3 h, set aside to allow the two phases to separate at 25 ◦C. Concentrations of copper(II) complexes in the aqueous phase before (C0) and after partitioning (Cw) were evaluated by spectrophotometry using the pyridyl ring bands (259 nm) of ligands.
